segments.text: Repeat each item after the speaker. Each item is given twice. Ready? Listen and repeat.
What? What? My? My? Today? Today? He? He? Who? Who? Is? Is? King? King? She? She?
money money a day hum a day hum Thomas our Thomas our either either manga manga
You will be given the question, idenda, followed by the name of an object.
In the pause that follows, recite your response using that object.
After each pause, the correct form of the response will be given for you to compare and to repeat once again.
It is a pen. It is a book. It is a book. It is a book. It is a book. It is a fruit. It is a fruit.
